name: zflac-downloader
description: Web frontend build for zFlac Downloader

scripts.build: cd web && npm ci && npm run generate && cd .. && rm -rf static && mkdir -p static && cp -a web/.output/public/. static/
scripts.heroku-postbuild: cd web && npm ci && npm run generate && cd .. && rm -rf static && mkdir -p static && cp -a web/.output/public/. static/
scripts.quality:all: npm run lint:web && npm run lint:go && npm run dupcheck
